blocks.text:
After breakfast, transfer to the airport according to the confirmed itinerary and fly to the Galápagos Islands. Flights from the mainland may depart from Quito or Guayaquil; flights from Quito may stop in Guayaquil. The exact flight itinerary is agreed when booking.

On arrival at Baltra Airport, your guide will meet you, help with your luggage and accompany you to the bus. The journey to the Itabaca Channel takes about 10 minutes.

The motorboat crossing to Santa Cruz Island takes approximately 5 minutes. Private transport then takes you across the island to Puerto Ayora, a journey of about 45 minutes. Along the way, the changing vegetation is easy to see: the dry, reddish terrain in the north gradually gives way to greener highlands and the southern part of the island.

En route, you will visit the interior of Santa Cruz. The route passes through agricultural areas to places where the famous Galápagos giant tortoises live.

You can observe the tortoises in their natural habitat. Private farms help protect the animals and their habitats. Here you may see young tortoises with smooth, shiny shells and very old individuals with cracks and other signs of a long life. Sometimes you can hear them pulling leaves from branches and moving slowly in search of food.

The islands are home to finches whose study played a significant role in the development of Darwin’s ideas about evolution.

Another part of the tour takes you to lava tunnels. These formed as lava flows cooled: the outer surface hardened while the molten rock inside continued to move.

Some sections have collapsed, but the surviving tunnels can be explored on foot. The walk takes about 30 minutes. Inside, there are narrow passages, large fallen boulders and sections where the structure of the lava flow is clearly visible.

Lunch is included.

After the transfer to the hotel and a welcome reception, check in. The rest of the day is free. You can walk around Puerto Ayora, visit the harbour and browse the souvenir shops.

Accommodation at Hotel Fiesta 4*.

**Meals:** breakfast, lunch.

blocks.text:
Early transfer to the Itabaca Channel for a boat trip to Bartolomé. The crossing takes about two hours. After climbing to the panoramic viewpoint, enjoy the beach, a boat ride and the opportunity to snorkel. Lunch on board, then return to Puerto Ayora in the afternoon.

Accommodation: Fiesta 3*. Meals: breakfast, lunch.
